description: Feature schema for RUL (Remaining Useful Life) regression model. Handed off for MLflow logging (Ossama) and API schema design (Hajar).

raw_input_columns.cycle: int, operational cycle number for this engine
raw_input_columns.sensor_1..sensor_21: float, raw sensor measurement at this cycle

engineered_features.description: For each sensor_i (i=1..21), three rolling window features computed causally (only past+current cycles, window=5, grouped per engine unit, never crossing unit boundaries).
engineered_features.sensor_i_roll_mean: float, rolling mean of sensor_i over last 5 cycles
engineered_features.sensor_i_roll_std: float, rolling std of sensor_i over last 5 cycles
engineered_features.sensor_i_roll_slope: float, rolling linear trend (least-squares slope) of sensor_i over last 5 cycles

target.name: RUL
target.definition: max_cycle(unit) - current_cycle for train; for test, computed using true RUL offset in RUL_FD001.txt
target.clipping: clipped at upper bound 125 cycles (standard C-MAPSS convention)

preprocessing.scaler: sklearn StandardScaler, fit ONLY on training data
preprocessing.warmup_rows_dropped: first (window-1)=4 rows per engine dropped (insufficient history for rolling features)

model_artifact.contents: dict with keys: model (GradientBoostingRegressor), scaler (StandardScaler), features (list[str])
model_artifact.notes_for_mlflow: log model via mlflow.sklearn.log_model(model_bundle['model'], ...); log scaler as a separate artifact (joblib) since MLflow sklearn flavor does not bundle preprocessing automatically.
